title: Update vinyl and HDD animations (alignment, mirroring, glow/particles, hover acceleration) and redeploy

requirements.text: Move the VinylPlayer’s vinyl record image closer to the “shibhi.studio” header wordmark and align the vinyl’s visual axis horizontally with the “shibhi.studio” wordline across relevant breakpoints.

quotes: bring the vinyl even more closer to shibhi.studio and alined as per axis point of vinyl with shibhi.studio wordline horizontally

acceptanceCriteria: On desktop (lg+), the vinyl record appears visually closer to the “shibhi.studio” wordmark than before (reduced gap), without overlapping the text.
The vinyl record is vertically aligned so its centerline feels horizontally aligned with the “shibhi.studio” wordline (no noticeable vertical misalignment).
No layout regressions on mobile: header text and vinyl remain readable and do not overflow the viewport.

requirements.text: Mirror the HDD tonearm motion so the arm’s swing/rotation appears on the right side of the platter (instead of the left), keeping the existing category-to-angle behavior but mirrored across the X axis.

quotes: directly mirror the working of arm based on x axis. ... you mirror it working and make those swings come on right side on the platter.

acceptanceCriteria: When hovering categories (or selecting a category), the tonearm rotates in the mirrored direction such that the visual sweep appears on the platter’s right side.
The arm’s rotation origin remains visually correct (no drifting/offset pivot).
Arm shadow (if present) remains aligned with the mirrored arm position/rotation.

requirements.text: Increase the HDD platter spin speed to 3× the previous speed, and on hover gradually accelerate to the faster speed (ease-in) rather than switching instantly.

quotes: increase the speed of hard disk by 3x times the old spedd and want to fastly gradually incease the speen when hover

acceptanceCriteria: The platter’s baseline spin speed is increased to ~3× the prior rate (relative visual comparison).
When the HDD becomes hovered/active, the spin rate ramps up smoothly (ease-in) instead of changing abruptly.
When not hovered/active, the platter returns smoothly to its baseline (no jarring snap).

requirements.text: Slightly reduce the opacity of the VinylPlayer play/pause toggle button while preserving accessibility (contrast and focus styles).

quotes: slightly reduce the opacity of the toggle play/pause button

acceptanceCriteria: The play/pause button appears slightly more translucent than before in its default state.
Hover/focus-visible states still clearly indicate interactivity and remain readable against the vinyl/background.
Button continues to toggle playback correctly (no functional changes).

requirements.text: Increase the glow intensity of the existing electron-link line and add visibly moving particles through it specifically while the target category is hovered (i.e., when ElectronHoverLink is active).

quotes: increase thr glowing of lines and make some particles moving through it while on hover

acceptanceCriteria: When a category is hovered and the electron link appears, the line is noticeably brighter/more “glowy” than before.
Particles visibly travel along the line while the link is active.
When no category is hovered (ElectronHoverLink inactive), particles/line are not rendered (or are fully absent as currently).

requirements.text: Perform a clean build and redeploy after applying the UI/animation updates, following the existing redeploy runbook/script behavior.

quotes: no please apply all what i said , build it now

acceptanceCriteria: Frontend builds successfully with no TypeScript errors.
The updated UI/animations are visible in the deployed app.

constraints: Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui (read-only); compose them as-is.
Do not modify frontend immutable hook files: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx.
Keep backend as a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo; add backend/migration.mo only if state schema changes (not expected for this request).
nonGoals: Add new authentication methods beyond Internet Identity.
Introduce external databases or third-party real-time systems (WebSockets, push, etc.).
Create new backend features unrelated to the UI/animation changes.
